DECLARE YOUR FREE CHOICES FIRST (MANDATORY when present): this spec requires a machine-readable declaration of 6 interface choice(s) (5 REQUIRED) BEFORE RTL authoring — see `/home/reyerchu/spm3_run/gf180mcuD/phase2/stage1/declaration_contract.json`. Decide them now, then write RTL that conforms, then emit the declaration:
    python3 plugins/vibe-ic/programs/spec_declaration_emit.py <project> --set <field>=<value> ...
The emitter REFUSES to write a declaration while any REQUIRED field is undetermined — it will name the field. Do NOT leave these to be re-derived from an RTL header comment later: a free choice recorded only in prose is a free choice a downstream tool has to guess.

class_config.name: digital_arithmetic_primitive
class_config.class_tree_node_basis: This name does two jobs and only one of them is a class. ic_class_profile uses it as the TERMINAL CATCH-ALL: all 11 corpus doc-sets carrying it record decisive_evidence 'L1/L2 present + no analog + no cmd protocol + no protocol/cpu signature -> arithmetic-primitive catch-all', i.e. they are UNCLASSIFIED, not classified as arithmetic. A floor hung here would score the classifier's uncertainty as the design's deficiency. digital-ic asserts only what that branch actually established (no analog, digital). If and when the catch-all is split from the real datapath class, the real one belongs at dsp-block; until then that mapping would cost 22 findings and crypto-engine 75, on 11 doc-sets nobody classified.
class_config.description: v1.6.522 — for #358 P2. Pure digital data-transform IP (multiplier, adder, filter, hash core, encoder/decoder, arithmetic sub-block). No SW-visible protocol / register map / calibration. Single top module with clock + reset + data ports. L4/L5/L6 legitimately N/A — L2 describes a deterministic combinational/sequential data transform. Phase 2 runner dispatches via fallback_skill=spec-to-rtl since there is no deterministic RTL generator for this open family.
